wallet.none: No supported wallet is available in this browser.

home.title: One shared schema. Independent issuers. Verifiable evidence.
home.description: XCS connects native XRPL Credentials to public schemas and integrity-protected off-ledger data.

keys.title: No custody
keys.copy: Keys remain in each entity’s wallet or HSM.

data.title: Off-ledger claims
data.copy: The ledger stores a cryptographically bound URI, not the credential data.

trust.title: Explicit trust
trust.copy: An active, intact credential is trustworthy only when your application recognizes its issuer.

learn.title: Understand XCS step by step
learn.intro: XCS is a deterministic convention on top of native XRPL Credentials, not a new blockchain or central authority.
learn.publisher: Account that registers a schema definition with the registry.
learn.issuer: Entity asserting a fact by creating the Credential with its own wallet.
learn.subject: Affected account that accepts the Credential before it becomes active.
learn.verifier: Application checking the ledger, schema, payload and its own trust policy.
learn.indexer: Service reading every validated ledger and reconstructing queryable state.
learn.registry: Blackholed account serving as the neutral destination for schema registrations.
learn.verification: XCS reports on-ledger state, schema validity, content integrity and issuer trust separately.

schemas.title: Public schemas
schemas.description: Every valid schema is reusable. Publication does not endorse its publisher or future issuers.
schemas.empty: No schema has been indexed on this profile yet.

register.title: Register a schema
register.description: JSON is validated and canonicalized before the complete definition is placed in a Payment memo.
register.irreversible: A validated registration is public and irreversible. Corrections require a new schema.
register.uidLater: The final UID depends on validated ledger context and will be displayed by the indexer.

issue.title: Issue a credential
issue.description: Prepare the off-ledger payload, publish its exact canonical bytes, then sign CredentialCreate.
issue.noPii: The Testnet and HTTPS payload are public: never enter personal data.
issue.httpsProof: Pilot mode requires a public HTTPS URL with CORS. Before signing, the browser re-downloads the exact canonical JSON without cache or redirects (maximum 1 MiB).
issue.checking: Checking the published HTTPS bytes immediately before signing…

accept.title: Accept or remove a credential
accept.description: Only the subject can accept. The subject or issuer can later delete the object according to XRPL rules.
accept.notTruth: Acceptance means retaining the Credential on your account; it does not certify that its claims are true.
accept.payloadConsentIntro: The next step contacts {host} directly from this browser. That host can observe your IP address and request time.
accept.payloadConsent: I explicitly consent to fetching this public payload from the displayed host.
accept.payloadUnavailable: The payload cannot be safely reviewed. Acceptance is blocked, but a pending credential may still be rejected.
accept.rejectSafety: Rejecting deletes this pending object without endorsing its issuer or claims.

revoke.title: Revoke an issued credential
revoke.description: The connected issuer selects the exact subject and schema before preparing CredentialDelete.
revoke.warning: Deletion is irreversible for this credential generation. Confirm the exact subject and schema in your wallet.

verify.title: Verify a credential
verify.description: Lookup requires the exact network, issuer, subject and schema UID.
verify.fetch: Resolve and check the public payload
verify.trustNote: Trust remains an application decision; XCS does not turn an unknown issuer into a recognized authority.

operations.title: Wallet operations
operations.description: Review submissions saved in this browser and resume those whose validation has not been confirmed yet.
operations.localOnly: The journal and recoverable signed blobs remain in IndexedDB on this device. No seed or private key is stored.
operations.empty: No wallet operation is stored in this browser.

footer.summary: XCS v0.1 — open standard and MIT reference implementation.
